$comment: Canonical production role assignments. Planner row updated by ADR-0023 (2026-08-11 09:49 EDT, post-Medium): planner flipped from qwen3_6-35b-a3b-q4kxl-gguf to qwen3_6-27b-q6k-gguf per quality-first tiebreak rule in bench/rubrics/medium-scored.json (4.3-point quality gap, outside 3-point band). Coder + embedder unchanged from ADR-0017.
co_residency_notes: Embedder is always resident (~5 GiB VRAM on llama.cpp GPU).
Only one of {coder, planner} holds VRAM at any moment.
Switching between coder and planner requires stopping the current large-model server before starting the other. See scripts/stop-large-model.sh.

coder.port_amendment_note: Port moved 8000 -> 8001 (2026-08-11 06:10 EDT, OpenHands agent on 8000) then 8001 -> 8100 (2026-08-11 06:24 EDT, OpenHands node frontend on 8001). See ADR-0017 amendments #1 + #2.

planner.selection_note: Flipped from qwen3_6-35b-a3b-q4kxl-gguf to 27b-q6k per ADR-0023: quality macro-avg 91.0 vs 86.7 (4.3-point gap outside 3-point tiebreak band). 35b-a3b-q4kxl remains latency-sensitive fallback (16.6s vs 80.8s total wall). Model file swap only — runtime, device, port, endpoint unchanged.

embedder.device_amendment_note: Device GPU->CPU per ADR-0017 amendment #3 (2026-08-11 06:39 EDT) to align with integration-execution-plan-v16 lines 159-161 (-ngl 0 -c 4096). Frees full 31.39 GiB VRAM for coder/planner.

vram_budget_gib.planner_resident_note: 22 GiB reflects 27B-Q6_K weights (~22 GiB). Prior value 21 GiB was for 35B-a3b-q4kxl. Embedder is CPU-resident (ADR-0017 amendment #3) so its 5 GiB is RAM not VRAM; VRAM headroom with planner hot = 32 - 22 = 10 GiB (embedder on CPU); table entry keeps embedder-VRAM column for legacy schema compatibility but should be read as 0.
